entities.summary: The Ali-Sadr Cave, originally called Ali Saadr or Ali Sard, is a water cave which attracts visitors every year. It is located in Ali Sadr, Kabudarahang County, about 100 kilometres (62 mi) north of Hamadan, western Iran.
